translations: then to Him you cry for help
puzzle.hint: A powerful reminder that every blessing comes from Allah, and He alone is our refuge in times of hardship
puzzle.arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍۢ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allāh. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
